name: Bilateral dumbbell farmer carry
definition: Stand holding one dumbbell at each side with the arms extended downward. Walk the recorded route while retaining the implements and the chosen upright posture.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand holding one dumbbell at each side with the arms extended downward.
value.movement: Walk the recorded route while retaining the implements and the chosen upright posture.
value.finish: Finish the measured distance before setting the implements down.
value.range_of_motion: Walking gait with no intended repeated trunk bending; record turns and route.
